Check voting eligibility using a nested if.

Supplied answer
age = int(input("Enter your age: "))
if age >= 18:
    if age <= 100:
        print("Eligible to vote")
    else:
        print("Please check the age entered")
else:
    print("Not eligible to vote")
Note: An if written inside another if is called a nested if.
